title: Lost Dogs Here Walk Home As PEOPLE 🐾
premise: In this town a lost dog walks home as a person, and nobody may call its name until it is home, so the man who spends the whole day on his favorite neighbors' porch waiting with them for their lost spaniel does not know he is the dog.
twist: Mr. Dale kneels and says You're home, Pepper, good boy, and the narrator, who ate the sausage set out for Pepper and sat on the step where Pepper always waited, is the spaniel.
world: A sunny street of pastel houses, the Dales' butter-yellow house with a wooden porch step, a blue leash on a peg and a photo taped to the front door, then golden hour, then a blue dusk with the porch light on.
